jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Nordics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Account Executive - Nordics

Our Senior Account Executives for public-sector customers help port authorities and national agencies plan and run their warehouse robotics programs.

You will build strong relationships with agency stakeholders, tailor your approach to their needs and present Cyberdyne's products in a clear, approachable way. You will measure your success by attainment of assigned quota.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive | Logistics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Account Executive, Logistics

Our Account Executives help freight carriers, 3PLs and distributors automate their back-office and dock operations with Cyberdyne's warehouse and document robotics.

Account Executives work on both new business and account management. We measure success by attainment of assigned quota, new logos and renewals.

jobs.title: Director of Sales Enablement
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Cyberdyne builds robotics software for warehouses and distribution centers. Over the last two years we have grown quickly and launched two new product lines.

At Cyberdyne, the enablement team exists to help our customer-facing teams ramp faster and sell better. As the Director of Sales Enablement you will build onboarding, coaching and certification for every seller.
